key_insight: SwarmEvolve accelerates evolutionary program search by letting large swarms of AI agents reason and exchange ideas in latent space instead of generating textual reasoning.
engineering_relevance: Latent-space collaboration offers a potentially faster, lower-cost way to discover programs for mathematical and scientific computing tasks.
method: Run hundreds of low-cost agents per round in swarms exploring different approaches.
Select distinct ideas using distances between agents’ hidden-state vectors.
Combine agents’ KV caches through a summarizer agent for latent-space crossover.
evidence_signal: Across 21 problems, SwarmEvolve reports the highest average score and median times of 3–8 minutes to match competitors’ best scores reached within 60 minutes.
watch_item: Practical deployment requires access to model hidden states and KV caches; the abstract does not establish portability across model architectures or hardware.
paper_title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
